global_issues.title: US-Israel Strikes on Iran Push Oil Higher, Equity Futures Lower
global_issues.note: Directionally correct but imprecise framing. There is no formal ceasefire collapse or fresh 'strikes' reported specifically on Aug 21-22; the active drivers are the reimposed naval blockade/Strait of Hormuz closure (in effect since May), fresh US sanctions threats ('toughest sanctions in history' per Bessent), and an Aug 18-19 Iranian ballistic missile launch toward UAE. Oil was indeed up on the week (Brent +5%) but eased slightly on Aug 21 itself. Also note US equities (S&P/Dow) actually rallied Fri Aug 21 on strong PMI data — 'equity futures lower' doesn't match the cash-market close.

global_issues.title: Longer-Dated Treasury Yields Rise as Bond Buyback Rally Fizzles
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC 8/21: 30-year yield rose ~3bp to 5.273% despite Bessent's buyback expansion signal; matches briefing exactly.

global_issues.title: Nvidia Denies China-Specific Chip Plans Amid Tightening Export Controls
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Nvidia denied The Information's report that it planned to ship a China-specific LPU by year-end. Timing (denial landing just before Nvidia's Aug 26 earnings) matches briefing context.

grok_report.summary: The three global issues are individually accurate but collectively overweight geopolitical/Iran risk as the session's driver while omitting the actual proximate cause of Friday's rally (strong PMI data) and TSLA's specific catalyst (Nevada robotaxi permit) — this produces a mood/sector narrative that's directionally passable but misattributed. Minor price discrepancies on NVDA/META are immaterial. No major factual errors, but the briefing reads as somewhat stale/incomplete relative to same-day news flow.
